{{Top|leg}}
The '''EM-03''' was a mid-range [[Missile/Legends|missile]] produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The EM-03 featured a moderate time-lock time, and discharged an intense electromagnetic pulse on impact; the charge was enough to destroy mines, seriously damage [[Drone/Legends|drones]], and deal minor damage to the hulls of enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
